rows.pass: Memory flat within the declared resource budget over the session (the growth rule of feature 192), 200 samples per device; thermal state and any tier change recorded.
rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, pods placed on sites by tap and with the panel, pods dragged to other sites and off the floor with the weather preview, vents toggled, the moon dragged and the moonlight set, the weather run, the shown cycle scrubbed, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.
rows.title: Memory, thermal state and the round-two stress session

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner taps sites and vents, drags pods, the moon and the scrubber, double-taps off the floor and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on an empty site sends exactly one pod.place to the first free slot, or says that every slot is used; a tap on a vent sends exactly one vent.set with its other state; a drag of a pod (16 points or more) shows the previewed weather from the kernel's own run with the pod drawn as a ghost and sends exactly one pod.place to the nearest site within 24 points or one pod.remove off the floor on release, and nothing when the target is unchanged; a vertical drag on the moon previews the moonlight one level per 40 points (clamped 0 to 3) and sends exactly one moon.set on release when it differs; a drag along the scrubber shows the nearest cycle under the finger; a gesture on a finished play explains why nothing happens; a double tap off the floor (within 0.35 s and 22 points) restores the authored view.
rows.procedure: Tap an empty site to place a pod, drag a pod to another site and off the floor to preview the weather and move or remove it, tap a vent to toggle it, drag the moon up and down to preview and set the moonlight, drag along the cycle scrubber to show a cycle, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap off the floor on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (Remove on an empty slot, which the rules refuse); change the selected slot and site with the panel to hear the site auditions; observe the ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
